name: whailmail
description: The app that makes handling your mail, a whale of a time!
author: https://github.com/whailmail

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:backend && pnpm run dev:frontend
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:backend && pnpm run clean:frontend
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run fmt && pnpm run test && pnpm run changelog
scripts.test:
printf 'Tests are not yet implemented.
  Reference for when they are: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend'
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.fmt: pnpm run fmt:backend && pnpm run fmt:frontend && pnpm run fmt:other
scripts.fmt:check: pnpm run fmt:check:backend && pnpm run fmt:check:frontend
scripts.audit: pnpm audit && cd backend && cargo audit
scripts.outdated: pnpm outdated && cd backend && cargo outdated
